verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.incident.io/llms.txt. That file is an llms.txt index linking an agent-oriented help-center text bundle covering 494 pages, so a user can point an agent straight at it. The reviewer's concern is valid: items docs-99 and docs-103 describe Twilio routing and audit logs, not agent-readable docs, so they are excluded. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and agent-doc offering and how to use it, on-topic evidence of the scope of the per-page markdown and API-reference exports, and independent corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.incident.io/llms.txt # incident.io
